notes: Single panel. Sheet is drawn roughly north-up with straight N-S / E-W streets; scale ~3.45 px per ft. Sycamore is the west edge (west side only 156/152 outlines); centre x~467-472 from both block lines and the pipe. Mulberry (printed 'E. MULBERRY', 60 ft measured, not printed) and Schiller (label only, ~34 ft) end at Sycamore from the west (156); named as on 156. Ringgold (50') runs from Walker east to the paper edge; Walker continues north off the sheet. North of Ringgold the only openings are Walker, a narrow ~12 ft gap at x~1954 and Josephine (x~3442, ~53 ft, printed 'JOSEPHINE'). The 12 ft gap is not named on the sheet; on the key map S. AUBURN AV. is the only street reaching Ringgold between Walker and Josephine (Bigelow dead-ends inside block 164), so it is named South Auburn Avenue -- uncertain. Pueblo jogs twice: between Alma and Walker it is only 18' (centre y~1577), east of Walker 40' (centre y~1543, its north line steps north), and at Drake it jogs ~120 px south (west leg centre y~1547, east leg centre y~1666, 40'). Hence two T points each at Walker (west/east legs) and at Alma (Alma north leg 55' centre x~984, south leg 30' centre x~943), and at Drake: Drake Street (40', from the north, centre x~2752) meets the west leg, and Drake Alley (printed 'DRAKE ALLEY', 14', centre x~2720) leaves the east leg southward to Boal. Boal is printed 'BOAL' (key map reads like BOAT) -- spelled Boal here. Alma (30' south of Pueblo) ends at Boal; an unnamed 10 ft 'ALLEY' continues its line from Boal to Milton, and across Milton the same line continues as 'VON SEGGERN' (printed without suffix, ~13-15 ft, '15'' printed) to Liberty, so Von Seggern/Milton is marked cross. A second unnamed 'ALLEY' (8-10 ft, x~1906) runs Milton to Liberty only. Milton is 40' west of Broadway (centre y~3009) and 50' east of Broadway (north line steps north, centre y~2987 at Cumber). Mansfield (60') runs Milton to Liberty; south of Liberty (153 outline) its 30 ft continuation is centred ~45 px further west, so Mansfield/Liberty is a T here (as on 153). Broadway (printed 38'6'', centre x~2338) starts at Milton; south of Liberty the 153 outline Broadway is centred ~85 px further west, so Broadway/Liberty is a T -- this north-of-Liberty street is the one sheet 153 recorded as '?' at its x 2202. Cumber (40') runs Milton to Liberty; no street opposite it south of Liberty. Thompson Court (printed 'THOMPSON CT.', 16') runs from behind the Milton lots south to Liberty past the vacant lot 424. Liberty is printed 33' at Sycamore and 38' near Cumber; centreline y~4118-4120 west, ~4111 at Cumber (north line not drawn along the vacant lot 424). East of Cumber the blocks are blank (sheet 158).
